content: The repository uses ChromaDB PersistentClient on a local path. Chroma documentation URLs returned 404 during this research; do not infer hosted production guarantees from that failure. Official pgvector documentation describes PostgreSQL vector search and warns shared approximate indexes across tenants can affect recall/performance; use owner predicates and evaluate exact/partitioned/per-user isolation. Hosted pgvector is a plausible beta default because it consolidates backups and tenancy enforcement with PostgreSQL; preserve Chroma for self-hosting.
